maddeler.e:
ننتشر (form VIII)
# نَنْتَشِرُ (nantaširu) /nan.ta.ʃi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَرَ (intašara)
# نَنْتَشِرَ (nantašira) /nan.ta.ʃi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَشَرَ (intašara)
# نَنْتَشِرْ (nantašir) /nan.ta.ʃir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَشَرَ (intašara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
